B is slightly richer on the status-code mapping and the indexing advice, but A's more accurate DRF guidance on the core complaint tips the balance.

B: Implies DRF CursorPagination with ordering=('-created_at','-id') uses id as a keyset tiebreaker (tuple comparison); DRF builds the cursor from the first ordering field only and resolves ties with an in-cursor offset.
